verdict.rationale: Shortwave is an email client (SaaS), so publishing an official MCP server for external agents is a fair axis. The evidence only shows Shortwave acting as an MCP client: its AI Assistant can connect to third-party or custom MCP servers via "Add custom integration." That client-side capability does not transfer to this story, and nothing documents a first-party Shortwave MCP server that external agents can connect to.
